faqs.answer: The UAW voted 321-287 at its Constitutional Convention in Detroit to divest its holdings in Israel Bonds, making it the first major US union to do so. The UAW holds at least 00,000 in Israel Bonds.
faqs.question: What did the UAW vote on?

faqs.answer: Unite All Workers for Democracy (UAWD), the reform caucus within the UAW, and UAW Labor for Palestine, part of the Labor for Palestine network that has pushed US unions to endorse BDS for over 20 years.
faqs.question: Who organized the divestment push?

faqs.answer: Israel Bonds (Development Corporation for Israel) raise money for the Israeli treasury. Human rights group DAWN called them "a sophisticated operation to enlist American public support for Israel's political projects" and called on them to register as a foreign agent.
faqs.question: Why are Israel Bonds controversial?

faqs.answer: Michigan divested all state pension investments in Israel Bonds in 2025. Maryland forced divestment of $73.7 million. The UK's largest public pension fund sold $29.2 million in Israeli bonds in May 2026. Brooklyn's Park Slope Food Coop voted to boycott Israeli products in May 2026.
faqs.question: What other divestment victories have happened?

faqs.answer: In 1973, Arab-American auto workers in Detroit walked off the job to protest the union's purchase of $300,000 in Israel Bonds. In 2014, UAW Local 2865 became the first major US labor union to endorse BDS by vote. In 2023, the UAW was the largest US union to back a ceasefire.

leadParagraph: The United Auto Workers voted 321 to 287 at its Constitutional Convention in Detroit to divest its holdings in Israel Bonds — the first major US union to do so. The push came from the UAWD reform caucus and UAW Labor for Palestine. UAW leadership initially removed the amendment from the agenda; it took a motion from the floor by Olga Karounos to force a vote. The UAW holds at least 00,000 in Israel Bonds. Palestine trade unions praised the "living conscience of the working class."
